clauses.requirement: The approval communication (Annex 1, para 9.1 concise description) shall include the entry for the reversing projector, with the details given in paras 9.1.7.1 and 9.1.7.2.
The approval communication shall state, for the reversing projector, whether it was tested together with the reversing lamp (yes/no; strike out what does not apply).
The approval communication shall state whether the luminous intensity of the reversing projector is intended to be reduced so as not to exceed 8.00∙10^3 cd (yes/no; strike out what does not apply).

The concise description in the approval communication shall be given for each light signalling function and category: mounting outside, inside or both; colour of light emitted (red/white/amber/colourless); number, category and kind of light source(s); whether the lamp is approved for LED substitute light source(s) and, if yes, their category; rated voltage or voltage range; whether it is a light source module and its specific identification code; whether limited to mounting height of 750 mm or less above ground, if applicable; geometrical conditions of installation and variations, if any; application of electronic light source control gear/variable intensity control (part of the lamp yes/no, not part of the lamp yes/no), its input voltage(s), manufacturer and identification number (when part of the lamp but not in the lamp body); variable luminous intensity if applicable; functions produced by an interdependent lamp forming part of an interdependent lamp system, if applicable; strike out what does not apply.

The approval communication shall state whether the front position, rear position, stop, end-outline marker, daytime running, parking, reversing, rear fog and side marker lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure (yes/no; strike out what does not apply).
The approval communication shall state whether an additional test was conducted according to paragraph 4.8.3.1.1 of this Regulation (yes/no; strike out what does not apply).
The approval communication shall state the position of the approval mark.
The approval communication shall state the reason(s) for extension of approval, if applicable.
